ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota Governor and Minneapolis Mayor
ideas.description: Investigate the DOJ's criminal probe into Minnesota Governor Tim Walz and Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey for alleged obstruction of federal law enforcement.
ideas.angle: The potential misuse of power by high-ranking officials and the impact on public trust.
questions: What are the specific allegations against Governor Walz and Mayor Frey?
ideas.insight: This story involves high-ranking officials and potential misuse of power, making it a high-priority investigation.
